title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.42: Fate Knocking's finisher preview now matches what the hit lands for when a modifier makes its strikes deal fractional damage (Weak, Vulnerable and friends). Damage truncates on each hit, so three strikes previewing at 4.5 really deal 4+4+4 - the preview was extrapolating the fraction and promising damage the card could not collect.
